name: zeroheight-audit-docs
description: Audit a zeroheight design system's documentation for machine-readability against the Design System Documentation Spec (DSDS 0.20.1). Reads your live styleguide through your own zeroheight MCP connection and returns a prioritised, page-by-page list of authoring moves plus ready-to-paste segments. With write access, pushes the fixes into zeroheight as drafts for review.

zeroheightMcpUrl.title: zeroheight remote MCP URL
zeroheightMcpUrl.description: Your zeroheight remote MCP URL. To audit, use your personal URL from zeroheight.com/settings/user/mcp (or a styleguide's Remote MCP details block). To push fixes into zeroheight as well, use https://mcp.zeroheight.com/mcp and sign in as an editor or admin.
